extracted.name: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Mashed Potatoes
extracted.description: This garlic mashed potato recipe with butter, milk, fresh parsley, and grated Parmesan cheese turns plain mashed potatoes into something special.
instruction_lines: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, 20 to 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté until soft, about 5 minutes.
Drain potatoes and return to the pot. Add garlic-butter mixture, milk, Parmesan cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper; mash until smooth.
